finding.reason: the terminal transition is an A0/40 service dispatch and never traverses the exception vector

interrupt_semantics.acknowledge: I_STAT is zero-to-clear; the write is followed by device-level resampling
interrupt_semantics.delivery: I_STAT & I_MASK drives COP0 hardware IP2; generated instructions sample Status.IE and Status.IM
interrupt_semantics.nesting: exception entry pushes the six low Status mode bits, disabling current IE; RFE restores them
interrupt_semantics.reassertion: DMA/CD/GPU/SIO/SPU reassert only while their underlying level remains active; VBlank is not resampled
interrupt_semantics.source: CRTC VBlank raises I_STAT bit 0 once at the exact vertical-end edge

limits: the committed route receipt does not include I_STAT, I_MASK, COP0 Status/Cause/EPC, or stack samples
therefore it cannot attribute any pending interrupt source or claim handler nesting
